text: 你醒来时，躺在一条窄而深切的小溪旁，身下是坚硬的卵石。突然，脑海中涌现出你遭遇过的种种恐怖景象。你猛地坐起，打量着峡谷两侧茂密、枝干光秃的白杨林和纸桦林。据你所知，附近没有危险，周围也只有你一个人。
你检查武器，发现身上只剩一把仍在鞘中的猎刀。你决定留在原地直到天亮，心里还抱着一丝希望，希望有人会找到你。清晨太阳驱散薄雾时，你终于放弃了这个念头。现在只剩你孤身一人。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 39
text: When you come to, you are lying on a hard bed of pebbles beside a small, deeply incised stream. Suddenly, your head is filled with visions of the terrors you have encountered. You sit bolt upright, scanning the dense, skeletal stands of aspen and paper birch on either side of the ravine. As far as you can tell, you are alone and in no immediate danger.

You check your weapons and find nothing but your hunting knife, still in its sheath. You decide to stay where you are until morning, in the faint hope that someone will find you. By the time the mists are burned off by the morning sun, you give up that hope. You are on your own.
